note: Unit identity rule 2: the 4x8x1 back pennant, its top 6 px above the head. The pole stands 4.25 px off the back, so a 9x9 cap clears it with the head turned the 30 degrees the rest pose allows; a troop with a taller head or a deeper helm moves it with offset, and a troop with a scaled body cancels that scale with the entry scale so the flag stays 4x8.
